sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- President Donald Trump, remarks to reporters, West Palm Beach, Friday evening, via Times of Israel liveblog 2026-11-07T02:24:46Z] The US military carried out new limited strikes on Iran, targeting an Iranian air-defence system near Qeshm Island. Trump called the action 'minor': 'They knocked out -- they built a little bit of an anti-aircraft device and we knocked it out in about 15 minutes, maybe five.' No further details on the target. [CONFIRMED FLOOR -- 0400-01] IRNA/Tasnim reported two projectiles impacting the Susa area of Qeshm Island, no casualties reported by semi-official outlets. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM, CONFLICTING -- Iranian accounts disagree on the drone] IRNA reports a US MQ-1 drone was brought down over Qeshm, the 16th of its kind destroyed there, by a newly developed IRGC air-defence system; separately IRIB / the Iranian army statement says a US MQ-9 was 'intercepted and destroyed' over the island. The US has not confirmed any drone loss. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- CENTCOM official to Al Jazeera, 22:55 GMT] Situation around Qeshm 'relatively calm'; CENTCOM 'will issue an announcement concerning Iran at 8:30am EST (13:30 GMT) on Saturday'. [PORTWATCH GAP -- STALE] Newest IMF PortWatch snapshot remains portwatch-2026-10-26.json, stale=true, latest observation 2026-10-18 (4 Hormuz transits, 7-day avg 3.7 vs 2025 baseline 85.5/day). NO fresh counted transit figure exists for this item and none is cited; hormuz.now Nov 7 update not yet published at scan time (last update 00:50 UTC, 12 crossings Nov 6, recorded 0600-02).
sections.what_verified: Trump's confirmation is carried by 1 declared-tier family (Times of Israel T3) plus untiered relays (Clash Report 02:48Z, Siasat, Business Standard -- attribution only, do not count). The confirmation is the President's own on-record statement to reporters; no contradiction from any US source. Strike details and damage remain unverified: no US damage assessment, no CENTCOM statement yet (due 13:30 GMT). The MQ-9 shootdown is an Iranian claim only.
sections.what_disputed: IRNA says a US MQ-1 was downed (16th of its kind, IRGC system); IRIB / Iranian army says a US MQ-9 was destroyed -- the two Iranian accounts conflict on the drone type, and neither claim is independently verified. CENTCOM has not confirmed any drone loss or strike details; its 22:55 GMT line was 'relatively calm'. Gulf News 'Trump confirms Qeshm strikes -- we watched it get built' (updated Nov 4) and American Frontline News (Nov 7 00:12Z) describe the NOV 2 strike, not this one -- re-date trap, do not merge.
sections.why_matters: Trump just confirmed it himself: the US hit Iran's air defence on Qeshm -- 'knocked it out in about 15 minutes.' Iran says it downed a US drone. But which drone? Tehran's own outlets can't agree.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE TO totw-20261107-0400-01 (Qeshm Island) -- Trump confirms US carried out limited strike on Iranian air defence; Iranian drone claims split MQ-1 vs MQ-9

totw_analysis: Our read: Trump just confirmed it himself: the US hit Iran's air defence on Qeshm -- 'knocked it out in about 15 minutes.' Iran says it downed a US drone. But which drone? Tehran's own outlets can't agree. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Trump calls the strike 'minor' and says talks with Tehran are going 'very well' -- is this a limited defensive hit, or the opening move of the resumed war?
